drone_dread_loop.wav.method: procedural: two detuned ~41.25 Hz harmonic oscillators beating at 0.33 Hz, a quieter pair near 62 Hz beating 0.5 Hz, tape wow as periodic phase modulation (0.79 Hz and 2.2 Hz), slow level breathing, FFT-periodic dark air, soft clip, 900 Hz lowpass; all integer cycles per 24 s so the loop is exact
